text: Every leading single-photon source relies on the strong-coupling (vacuum Rabi) regime of cavity QED, while the Purcell effect is used only for gates.
explanation: False, the roles are reversed. The book states 'Purcell is for sources, strong coupling is for gates': leading single-photon sources are weak-coupling Purcell devices, whereas strong coupling and photon blockade enable deterministic photon-photon gates.
